podcast.title: Three Doors Down's Signing
podcast.body: Three Doors Down secured a deal with Republic Records after a performance at CBGB caught their attention. This led to the release of their multi-platinum debut album, "The Better Life." "A gig at CBGB got the attention of Republic Records, a subsidiary of Universal Music, and they signed them to a deal."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Universal Music Subsidiary
podcast.body: Republic Records is identified as a subsidiary of Universal Music, indicating its position within a major music conglomerate. "Republic Records, a subsidiary of Universal Music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
